leads.summary: Skill Orbit's posting describes a learning and career platform for emerging professionals. Its website describes a digital transformation agency offering web, mobile, UI/UX, graphic design and integration services.
leads.hook: The posting is a remote data analyst internship (Excel, SQL, dashboards), and the website describes a different business.
leads.angle_reason: Not relevant: the only open role is a non-engineering data analyst internship, and no project fits it.
red_flags: internship stipend starts at Rs 20,000/month, below Rs 25,000

leads.summary: Paasa is a mobile app that lets Indians invest in US stocks, ETFs and UCITS funds from India, with automated cross-border tax reports. The site says it is a SEBI registered RIA and that assets are held with Interactive Brokers in the client's name.
leads.hook: Your blog post comparing UCITS and US ETFs for RSU holders, and the year-end Schedule FA and capital gains reports the platform generates automatically.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's JWT auth with refresh-token rotation and per-user isolation at the queryset level is the account-security layer a brokerage app needs.

leads.summary: Techolution sells enterprise AI automation through its BPA 4.0 platform and consulting, and says it has served 352 enterprises across manufacturing, banking, retail, insurance and healthcare.
leads.hook: Your BPA 4.0 page claims a 42x efficiency gain in 30 days for a large enterprise client.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's Gemini pipeline with a fixed JSON output schema and one mockable LLM client is the kind of production LLM work an enterprise AI automation firm ships.

leads.summary: Bharat Digital runs a six-month paid fellowship that places early-career engineers, designers and AI practitioners inside Indian government departments to improve public systems.
leads.hook: Your past-cohort list includes the eSankhyiki MCP server, which makes official statistics callable by AI assistants.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's per-user data isolation and privacy rules for LLM output match building citizen-facing systems that hold sensitive personal data.
red_flags: application deadline (18 Oct 2026) has already passed

leads.summary: TestAIng (AiEnsured) provides AI product engineering, LLM and agent development, and AI testing, validation and governance services for enterprises in BFSI, HR tech, retail and healthcare.
leads.hook: Your AI/ML intern posting asks for LLM fine-tuning shown in a project, plus agent development and evaluation scripts.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's LLM pipeline with schema-constrained output and a 47-test suite that runs without an API key matches the evaluation-heavy LLM work this team does.

leads.summary: Morningstar is a publicly listed investment research and data company. Its site publishes market data, fund and stock analysis, and investor tools.
leads.hook: The posting asks for C#, .NET 8, Entity Framework and AWS Lambda/Fargate, which is not the candidate's stack.
leads.angle_reason: Not relevant: a large public enterprise (1000+ people) with no direct-contact culture, and the required .NET stack does not match the candidate's Django/React background.

leads.summary: Curtins is an employee-owned engineering consultancy in the UK and Ireland, covering civils and structures, transport planning, and geotechnical and environmental work on development projects.
leads.hook: The graduate role is transport planning (Transport Assessments, junction studies, planning applications), not software engineering.
leads.angle_reason: Not relevant: the only open role is a non-engineering graduate transport planner, and no project fits it.

leads.summary: Chainguard rebuilds open-source container images, language packages and CI/CD actions from source daily, so teams can ship with fewer CVEs and less exposure to malware. Customers include Canva, OpenAI and Snowflake.
leads.hook: The role is a senior International Business Development Representative for the Nordics, doing technical outbound to security and platform teams.
leads.angle_reason: Not relevant: the only open role is a senior sales (BDR) position, not an engineering role.

leads.summary: CloudSEK builds predictive attack-path intelligence: graph-based analysis of external attack surface, dark web, data leak and supply-chain signals, sold to enterprises and Fortune 500 companies.
leads.hook: Your site announces a CloudSEK MCP Server, a recent launch the frontend team would have shipped.
leads.angle_reason: Canopy's deterministic cross-file call-graph resolution is close to the graph-based attack-path construction CloudSEK does, and its security-tooling focus matches the product.

leads.summary: Helios builds AI agents that answer, qualify and book meetings across WhatsApp, Instagram, phone calls and email, syncing each conversation to the customer's CRM.
leads.hook: Your guardrails setup uses a 0.85 confidence threshold with human handoff on from day one, a design choice worth discussing.
leads.angle_reason: MedVault's Django API with JWT auth and an LLM pipeline behind one mockable client is the same shape as Helios's agent that answers, qualifies and syncs to CRMs.
